'''Hrannik''' was a [[Shamed Ones|Shamed One]] living beneath the surface of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] and transformed into [[Yuuzhan'tar]]. Although a [[Jeedai heresy|heretic]], Hrannik was one of the few Shamed Ones who lived independently of the larger groups, ensuring that their small cult of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] followers would never be fully discovered. Hrannik spent much of her time spreading the knowledge of the Jedi to others in hopes of the heresy to the higher ranks.
